lines.zh: 摆尾前行，水里的臭味跟着我。
lines.en: I swim on, and my stench follows the water.

lines.zh: 女巫温室的水太浅，我贴着底走。
lines.en: The witch's greenhouse water is shallow; I skim the bottom.

lines.zh: 鱼鳍划开水面，留下一道油光。
lines.en: My fin cuts the surface and leaves a slick.

lines.zh: 我闻着味找路，越臭越对。
lines.en: I follow the smell; the worse it stinks, the righter.

lines.zh: 一排牙露在外面，游起来更吓人。
lines.en: A row of teeth shows as I swim, which is the point.

lines.zh: 水里转弯要慢，我这条鱼太重。
lines.en: Turning is slow in water; this fish is heavy.

lines.zh: 玻璃缸外的人影，从我上方晃过。
lines.en: Shadows of people pass above the glass tank wall.

lines.zh: 我逆着水流走，臭味散得更远。
lines.en: I swim upstream; my stench spreads farther that way.

lines.zh: 水草缠住尾巴，我一口咬断。
lines.en: Weeds snag my tail, and I bite them through.

lines.zh: 泡泡一路往上冒，带着臭气。
lines.en: Bubbles rise the whole way, carrying my stink.

lines.zh: 我的鳃盖一开一合，滤着臭水。
lines.en: My gill covers open and shut, sifting the foul water.

lines.zh: 温室的排水口，是我最爱的地方。
lines.en: The greenhouse drain is my favorite place to swim.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，浊水就翻起来。
lines.en: One tail beat and the murky water churns up.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底，等谁把脚伸下来。
lines.en: I hug the bottom, waiting for a foot to dangle.

lines.zh: 我顺着排水沟游，找到新的水。
lines.en: I follow the drain channel and find fresh water.

lines.zh: 有人往水里丢东西，我冲过去。
lines.en: Someone drops something in; I rush over.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，张嘴又合上。
lines.en: I hover in the water, mouth opening and closing.

lines.zh: 臭味在水里散开，像一层雾。
lines.en: My stench spreads in water like a layer of fog.

lines.zh: 女巫把我养在温室，说是观赏用。
lines.en: The witch keeps me in her greenhouse for display.

lines.zh: 我不用动，猎物会自己送上门。
lines.en: I need not move; prey comes to me.

lines.zh: 牙齿碰在一起，咔的一声。
lines.en: My teeth click together once, sharply.

lines.zh: 水面飘着几片烂叶，我懒得理。
lines.en: Rotting leaves float above; I ignore them.

lines.zh: 我吐了个泡，泡里全是臭气。
lines.en: I blow a bubble, and it is full of stink.

lines.zh: 有人在玻璃外看我，我装作没看见。
lines.en: Someone watches through the glass; I pretend not to notice.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片黏糊糊的，一碰就沾手。
lines.en: My scales are slimy and stick to any hand.

lines.zh: 水温刚好，我慢慢晃着鳍。
lines.en: The water is just right; I sway my fins.

lines.zh: 一天里最舒服的事，就是不动。
lines.en: The best part of my day is not moving.

lines.zh: 温室里药草的味道，盖不住我的臭。
lines.en: Greenhouse herbs cannot cover my smell.

lines.zh: 我记得女巫撒食的时间。
lines.en: I remember when the witch scatters my food.

lines.zh: 这缸水该换了，我闻得出来。
lines.en: This tank needs fresh water; I can tell.

lines.zh: 你把脸贴到玻璃上，牙印还留着。
lines.en: Press your face to the glass; the tooth marks remain.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手指，隔着水。
lines.en: I watch your fingers through the water.

lines.zh: 你皱鼻子了，我的味道到了吧。
lines.en: You wrinkled your nose; my smell reached you.

lines.zh: 我浮上来，只为看清你的脚踝。
lines.en: I rise only to get a clear look at your ankles.

lines.zh: 你的倒影在水里晃，我追了两下。
lines.en: Your reflection sways; I chase it twice.

lines.zh: 女巫的客人，一般都很好吃。
lines.en: The witch's guests are usually quite tasty.

lines.zh: 我歪着鱼头，猜你会不会下水。
lines.en: I tilt my fish head, guessing if you will wade in.

lines.zh: 你看我丑，我看你肥。
lines.en: You think I am ugly; I think you are plump.

lines.zh: 别敲玻璃，我的牙会痒。
lines.en: Do not tap the glass; it makes my teeth itch.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛长在两边，专看背后。
lines.en: My eyes sit on both sides, watching behind you.

lines.zh: 你砍到我的鳍，血在水里散开。
lines.en: You cut my fin, and blood blooms in the water.

lines.zh: 鳞片掉了一片，底下是粉肉。
lines.en: A scale falls off, showing the flesh beneath.

lines.zh: 疼得我翻了个身，肚皮朝天。
lines.en: The pain flips me over, belly to the surface.

lines.zh: 你打中我了，臭味更浓了。
lines.en: You hit me, and my stink grows stronger.

lines.zh: 我在水里躲，你的刀追着来。
lines.en: I dodge in the water; your blade follows.

lines.zh: 这一下够我记你一整天。
lines.en: This one blow I will remember all day.

lines.zh: 我的血也是腥的，你闻到了吧。
lines.en: My blood is fishy too; you can smell it.

lines.zh: 别以为鱼不会还手。
lines.en: Do not assume a fish cannot hit back.

lines.zh: 伤口泡在水里，疼得更清楚。
lines.en: The wound soaks in water and throbs clearly.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，又从另一边浮起来。
lines.en: I sink, then surface on the other side.

lines.zh: 你手里的鱼，比你的手指香。
lines.en: The fish in your hand smells better than your fingers.

lines.zh: 我游过来，只为了那一小块肉。
lines.en: I swim over for that one scrap of meat.

lines.zh: 女巫喂我时也这样晃，我认得。
lines.en: The witch waves food just like that; I know it.

lines.zh: 别缩手，缩手我就咬空。
lines.en: Do not pull back; pulling back makes me miss.

lines.zh: 臭味里混进食物的味道，很清楚。
lines.en: Food smell cuts through my stink, quite clearly.

lines.zh: 我围着你的手转圈，忍着不咬。
lines.en: I circle your hand and hold my bite back.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，我就当你是饵。
lines.en: Come a little closer and I will treat you as bait.

lines.zh: 我吃得很急，连水一起吞下去。
lines.en: I eat fast, swallowing water along with it.

lines.zh: 食物到手，我就退回水底。
lines.en: Once I have the food, I sink back down.

lines.zh: 你喂我一次，我就记住你的味道。
lines.en: Feed me once, and I remember your flavor.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，撞到我的背鳍。
lines.en: You step into the water and hit my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 我身子一滑，从你腿边挤过去。
lines.en: I slip past, squeezing along your leg.

lines.zh: 湿滑的鳞蹭你一下，够你洗半天。
lines.en: One rub of my slick scales and you need a bath.

lines.zh: 别在水里乱踢，我在下面。
lines.en: Stop kicking in the water; I am down here.

lines.zh: 我顶你小腿，像顶一块浮木。
lines.en: I nudge your shin like a floating log.

lines.zh: 撞上我的鱼身，你脚下一滑。
lines.en: You bump my body and your footing slips.

lines.zh: 水花溅起来，臭味也跟着上来。
lines.en: Water splashes up, and the stink comes with it.

lines.zh: 我不让路，鱼也有鱼的道。
lines.en: I will not yield; fish have their own right of way.

lines.zh: 你的靴子压到我尾巴了。
lines.en: Your boot is pressing on my tail.

lines.zh: 挤过来之前，先想想我的牙。
lines.en: Before you squeeze past, think about my teeth.

lines.zh: 同类之间，先比谁的牙更密。
lines.en: Between my kind, we compare tooth density first.

lines.zh: 我产卵在水草后面，别去翻。
lines.en: I lay my eggs behind the weeds; do not dig there.

lines.zh: 配偶要够臭，才算合格。
lines.en: A mate must stink enough to qualify.

lines.zh: 女巫不知道，缸里其实有两条。
lines.en: The witch does not know there are two of us.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，水都变浑了。
lines.en: We swim side by side until the water clouds.

lines.zh: 交配之后，我连伴侣都想咬。
lines.en: After mating I want to bite even my partner.

lines.zh: 卵粘在缸壁上，一排排的。
lines.en: Eggs stick to the tank wall in neat rows.

lines.zh: 求偶要绕圈，绕得越久越诚心。
lines.en: Courtship means circling; the longer, the sincerer.

lines.zh: 两条鱼挤在温室角落，水都臭了。
lines.en: Two fish crowd the greenhouse corner; the water reeks.

lines.zh: 别打扰，我们正在办正事。
lines.en: Do not interrupt; we are busy with important business.

lines.zh: 沉底的肉块，我一口吸进去。
lines.en: The meat that sank, I suck up in one go.

lines.zh: 掉进水里的东西，都算我的。
lines.en: Whatever falls into the water counts as mine.

lines.zh: 我用嘴捡，捡完还得漱漱水。
lines.en: I pick it up with my mouth, then rinse it.

lines.zh: 那块面包泡软了，正好入口。
lines.en: That bread is soaked soft, perfect for eating.

lines.zh: 你掉的钥匙沉下来，我叼着玩。
lines.en: The key you dropped sinks, and I mouth it.

lines.zh: 缸底的碎壳，我一个个收进角落。
lines.en: I gather the shell bits on the floor into a corner.

lines.zh: 捡东西时我会翻个身，露出白肚。
lines.en: Picking it up, I roll and show my pale belly.

lines.zh: 这块布吸水后太重，我拖不动。
lines.en: This cloth is too heavy wet; I cannot drag it.

lines.zh: 我先闻一遍，再决定要不要。
lines.en: I sniff it first, then decide whether to keep it.

lines.zh: 谁也别抢，水底的东西归鱼。
lines.en: Nobody grab it; sunken things belong to fish.

lines.zh: 血味一散开，我就知道该咬谁。
lines.en: When blood spreads, I know who to bite.

lines.zh: 你脚踝上有伤，我看见了。
lines.en: There is a cut on your ankle; I saw it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，把牙对准你。
lines.en: I turn slowly until my teeth point at you.

lines.zh: 目标不大，但够我吃一顿。
lines.en: The target is small but enough for one meal.

lines.zh: 水里挣扎的东西，最容易被盯上。
lines.en: Things that thrash in water get noticed first.

lines.zh: 你踩水的声音，像在敲我的碗。
lines.en: Your splashing sounds like someone tapping my bowl.

lines.zh: 我浮上来了，这不是好兆头。
lines.en: I have surfaced, and that is not a good sign.

lines.zh: 女巫说过别咬客人，我尽量。
lines.en: The witch said not to bite guests; I try.

lines.zh: 目标锁定，剩下的交给牙。
lines.en: Target locked; the rest is up to my teeth.

lines.zh: 你退到岸上，我就没兴趣了。
lines.en: Retreat to dry land and I lose interest.

lines.zh: 我潜到水底，只露出眼睛。
lines.en: I sink low and show only my eyes.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我的头就转到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you walk, my head turns to follow.

lines.zh: 我等你的脚再往下踩一寸。
lines.en: I wait for your foot to sink one inch more.

lines.zh: 水面上的涟漪，是我在下面动。
lines.en: The ripples above are me moving below.

lines.zh: 别以为水浑就看不清你。
lines.en: Do not think murky water hides you from me.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，找最软的地方。
lines.en: I circle you, looking for the softest spot.

lines.zh: 你握着武器，我就等你松手。
lines.en: You hold a weapon; I wait for you to lower it.

lines.zh: 我在数你的心跳，变快了。
lines.en: I am counting your heartbeat, and it quickened.

lines.zh: 再站一会儿，你的脚就麻了。
lines.en: Stand there a while longer and your feet go numb.

lines.zh: 我不急着咬，先让你怕。
lines.en: I do not rush the bite; first I let you fear.

lines.zh: 一口下去，你的小腿就见了血。
lines.en: One bite and your calf starts bleeding.

lines.zh: 我的牙往里钩，拔出来才疼。
lines.en: My teeth hook inward; the pain comes on removal.

lines.zh: 我咬一口就退，水花替我掩护。
lines.en: I bite once and retreat under cover of splashing.

lines.zh: 你挥剑，水里根本使不上力。
lines.en: You swing your sword; water steals the force.

lines.zh: 这条腿，我留着下一顿吃。
lines.en: I will save this leg for my next meal.

lines.zh: 血混进水里，我的同类会来。
lines.en: Blood mixes with the water; my kin will come.

lines.zh: 咬住不放，直到你把我甩开。
lines.en: I hold the bite until you shake me off.

lines.zh: 我翻身一咬，牙擦过你的靴子。
lines.en: I roll and bite; my teeth scrape your boot.

lines.zh: 疼吗，我咬的时候下巴也疼。
lines.en: Does it hurt? My jaw aches too when I bite.

lines.zh: 你把我踢开，我转头又回来。
lines.en: You kick me away; I turn and come back.

lines.zh: 女巫把水倒进缸里，我就在里面了。
lines.en: The witch poured water in the tank, and there I was.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，四周全是药草。
lines.en: When I opened my eyes, herbs surrounded me.

lines.zh: 温室的水有点甜，我不太习惯。
lines.en: The greenhouse water is sweetish; I am not used to it.

lines.zh: 刚出生就这么臭，是天生的。
lines.en: This smelly at birth; it is simply inborn.

lines.zh: 缸太小，我转个身都费劲。
lines.en: The tank is small; even turning is a chore.

lines.zh: 我第一口吃的是水草上的虫。
lines.en: My first meal was a bug on the waterweed.

lines.zh: 有人的影子靠近，我本能地张嘴。
lines.en: A shadow nears, and my mouth opens by instinct.

lines.zh: 我把卵壳吞了，不能浪费。
lines.en: I swallow the egg casing; nothing goes to waste.

lines.zh: 这池水会记住我的味道。
lines.en: This pool will remember my smell.

lines.zh: 女巫说我很珍贵，我不信。
lines.en: The witch calls me precious; I do not believe her.

lines.zh: 水面烫起来，我跳了两下。
lines.en: The water heats up and I thrash twice.

lines.zh: 摔在地上，我拍着尾巴直喘。
lines.en: Dropped on dry ground, I flap and gasp.

lines.zh: 水草堵住鳃，我喘不上气。
lines.en: Weeds clog my gills and I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 气浪把我从水里掀了出来。
lines.en: The blast throws me clear out of the water.

lines.zh: 箭射穿水面，钉进我的侧腹。
lines.en: An arrow pierces the surface and sticks in my flank.

lines.zh: 药水味太冲，我的鳃全缩了。
lines.en: The potion reek is too strong; my gills clamp shut.

lines.zh: 饿了三天，我连水草都啃。
lines.en: Three days hungry, I even chew the waterweed.

lines.zh: 电顺着我的臭水窜到尾巴。
lines.en: The current runs through my foul water to my tail.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我张着嘴乱摆。
lines.en: No water in the void; I gape and flail.
